title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Syracuse University
description: Verified food destinations with evening or late-night availability on or near Syracuse University.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: 137 Marshall St, Syracuse, NY 13210
cards.notes: Check the location’s ordering page or call ahead before leaving; its listed late hours make it a dessert-focused option near the university.
cards.short_summary: A Marshall Street cookie shop with the latest listed hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: The Syracuse location is listed at 137 Marshall Street, with hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday; 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Thursday–Friday; noon–3 a.m. Saturday. Confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Over The Cuse Pizza & Wings
cards.subtitle: 399 S Crouse Ave, CODA Building
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering page to confirm the day’s availability, then plan pickup at the Crouse Avenue CODA Building location.
cards.short_summary: Pizza, wings, and other carryout items on South Crouse Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s ordering page lists the 399 South Crouse Avenue location and hours until 1:30 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Over The Cuse Pizza & Wings — online ordering
cards.access_notes: Listed hours run to 1:30 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; Monday–Wednesday are listed to 11:30 p.m. Confirm before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Over the Cuse Deli and Grill
cards.title: Over the Cuse Deli and Grill
cards.subtitle: 712 E Fayette St, Syracuse, NY 13210
cards.notes: Use the contact page’s weekly schedule when timing a pickup; Thursday through Saturday have the latest listed closing times.
cards.short_summary: A deli-and-grill destination east of campus with weekend late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Over the Cuse Deli and Grill lists its Fayette Street address and hours until 2 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Over the Cuse Deli and Grill — Contact
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: midnight Monday–Wednesday and 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; closed Sunday. Confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Syracuse Halal Gyro
cards.subtitle: 477 Westcott St, Syracuse, NY 13210
cards.notes: This Westcott Street stop lists takeout and limited seating; check its current ordering status before heading over late.
cards.short_summary: A halal-food destination on Westcott Street with very late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Syracuse Halal Gyro is listed at 477 Westcott Street, and the Westcott Community page lists its hours as 10 a.m.–3 a.m.
cards.source_title: Westcott Grocery & Syracuse Halal Gyro — Westcott Community
cards.access_notes: The Westcott Community listing gives Syracuse Halal Gyro hours as 10 a.m.–3 a.m. The restaurant’s site says takeout and limited seating; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Franco's Pizzeria & Deli
cards.subtitle: 901 E Genesee St, Syracuse, NY 13210
cards.notes: For a late delivery run, check the restaurant’s service area and minimum first; the site specifically includes Syracuse University.
cards.short_summary: An East Genesee pizzeria and deli that lists overnight delivery service.
cards.evidence_claim: Franco’s lists delivery to Syracuse University and surrounding areas until 3 a.m. daily; Friday and Saturday menu hours are listed until midnight.
cards.access_notes: The site lists delivery to the university and surrounding areas until 3 a.m. daily, with a $15 delivery minimum. Confirm before ordering.

cards.title: Tazza
cards.subtitle: 466 Westcott St, Syracuse, NY 13210
cards.notes: Plan around the published daily schedule and use the Westcott Street address for an evening food stop rather than assuming all services run late.
cards.short_summary: A Westcott Street restaurant listing midnight closing most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Tazza lists hours until midnight Monday through Saturday and until 10 p.m. Sunday at 466 Westcott Street.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11 a.m.–midnight Monday–Saturday and 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday. Confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Funk 'n Waffles
cards.subtitle: 307–13 S Clinton St, Syracuse, NY 13202
cards.notes: Check the daily schedule before traveling downtown, especially because Tuesday is listed closed and Wednesday has a shorter daytime window.
cards.short_summary: A downtown food-and-music venue with midnight hours on most listed days.
cards.evidence_claim: Funk ’n Waffles lists its South Clinton Street location as open until midnight Sunday, Monday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and today.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours extend to midnight Sunday, Monday, Thursday–Saturday; Tuesday is closed and Wednesday is listed 9 a.m.–4 p.m. Confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Oishi Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 701-5 S Crouse Ave, Syracuse, NY 13210
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering option or call to verify dinner service before walking to the South Crouse Avenue address.
cards.short_summary: A Japanese and Asian restaurant that lists 11 p.m. dinner closing Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.evidence_claim: Oishi Restaurant lists its location near Syracuse University and dinner/carryout hours until 11 p.m. Tuesday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed dinner and carryout hours are 4–11 p.m. Tuesday–Sunday; delivery hours also extend to 11 p.m. Confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Schine Dining
cards.subtitle: Schine Student Center, Syracuse University
cards.notes: Use Campus Dining’s live hours page before heading to the student center, since the university notes that semester and summer schedules can vary.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus food hall identified by Syracuse University as open late on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Syracuse University says Schine Dining is in the Schine Student Center and is open late on weekends.
cards.source_title: Retail Shopping and Dining — Syracuse University
cards.access_notes: The university identifies Schine Dining as open late on weekends and directs visitors to its current Food Hall Hours page; schedules may change.

cards.title: Goldstein Food Hall

cards.notes: Check Campus Dining’s live schedule before going to South Campus; this is the university’s named food-hall option in Goldstein Student Center.

cards.evidence_claim: Syracuse University says Goldstein Food Hall is on the lower level of Goldstein Student Center and is open late on weekends.
